description: Who pays my x402 API, and do they come back? Customer analytics for an x402 seller from USDC payments on Base: repeat buyers versus one-off and sweep-like payers, revenue per payer and weekly retention cohorts. Use when an agent needs payer analytics for a pay-to address. Agoranome pledges 15% of settled revenue to a cause, verifiable at /impact/ledger. Price: $0.05 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Failed calls aren't charged.
